These automation extensions are separate from the pinned Chrome wire schema and its coverage counts.

| Name | Status | Scope and limitations | Regression evidence |
|---|---|---|---|

| `Mimic.captureSnapshot` | partial | Static portable DOM/assets snapshot with base64 file bodies and capture timings. Snapshot errors and supported resource limitations remain visible; no rendering backend is implied. | [TestCaptureSnapshotCDP](../internal/cdp/snapshot_test.go); [TestSnapshotInterruptReservesTaskBoundary](../internal/cdp/snapshot_boundary_test.go) |
| `Mimic.clearTrace` | partial | Session command; current runtime behavior only. Exact lifecycle and diagnostic payload coverage is incomplete. |  |
